title: Minimap dragging lets stale navigation overwrite the current target
outcome: Minimap dragging lets stale navigation overwrite the current target
acceptance: A newer minimap target supersedes earlier pending history responses and delayed scroll work, including a target already resident.
Minimap dragging maintains a stable pointer target through loading and layout updates and ends at the latest requested message.
Focused UI regression tests and TypeScript validation pass; the UI fix is available in the main checkout for Greg to exercise.
